plugins.name: safety-guard
plugins.description: Blocks destructive shell commands and access to secret files (.env, SSH keys, cloud credentials).

plugins.name: secret-scrub
plugins.description: Masks or blocks API keys, tokens and private keys in your prompt before they reach the model.

plugins.name: notify-router
plugins.description: Rules for alerts: done, blocked (if still waiting), error and context or rate-limit usage, to a chime, macOS notifications and ntfy, with quiet hours and dedupe.

plugins.name: status-bar
plugins.description: A one-line status bar above the prompt: folder, git branch and state, 5-hour and 7-day usage bars, context with tokens, prompt-cache countdown, cost, session time, turns and clock. Desktop app only.

plugins.name: focus-panel
plugins.description: A panel above the prompt after each response: what needs you, errors, the next action with its task id, open to-dos and heads-ups.

plugins.name: handover
plugins.description: /handover writes a handover note from the conversation (served from the prompt cache), saves it under ~/.claude/projects/<project>/handovers/<session-title>.md, clears the session and continues from the note in a fresh context. Suggests it when context passes a threshold.

plugins.name: read-budget
plugins.description: Stops Claude from re-reading the same large, unchanged file in full again and again in one session: past a limit it is pointed to Grep or a ranged Read instead.

plugins.name: worktree-hints
plugins.description: In a worktree session, tells Claude up front which commands the worktree guard refuses (heredoc and inline-script edits, multi-line scripts, cd to computed paths), so it uses Edit and plain commands instead of retrying.
